how_to_join: To join any ministry, talk with its leader after the Divine Liturgy, or call or text Fr. Arkady.

parish.name: Choir
parish.text: The choir leads the singing of our services. Almost all of Orthodox worship is sung, and new voices are always welcome.
parish.image_alt: The parish choir singing at music stands in the church

parish.name: Kitchen and Fellowship
parish.text: Prepares coffee hour and parish meals, from Sunday mornings to feast-day potlucks, so that everyone has a place at the table.
parish.image_alt: A smiling parishioner in an apron at a table in the parish hall

parish.name: Bookstore
parish.text: Our small bookstore offers books, icons and cards to help you learn and pray at home.
parish.image_alt: Shelves of books and icons in the parish bookstore

parish.name: Stewardship
parish.text: Helps the parish care for all that God has given us, through yearly pledges and the gifts that keep our church open.
parish.image_alt: The St. Elizabeth New Martyr Mission pledge card, where parishioners write their yearly offering

parish.short: Digital Content / Website / Photos and Videos
parish.name: Digital Content, Website, Photos and Videos
parish.text: Keeps our website, announcements, photos and videos up to date, so parishioners and visitors know what is happening.
parish.image_alt: A parish announcement listing the Holy Week services

parish.name: Building and Maintenance
parish.text: Cares for our 1883 church building: repairs, improvement projects and clearing the snow in winter.
parish.image_alt: A parishioner clearing snow outside the church with a snow shovel

parish.name: Charity and Outreach
parish.text: Following St. Elizabeth's example of mercy, we collect and give help to neighbors in need.
parish.image_alt: A parishioner smiling beside long tables filled with bread and food in the parish hall

parish.name: Greeters and Hospitality
parish.text: Welcomes visitors at the door, helps them follow the service and makes sure no one stands alone at coffee hour.
parish.image_alt: Three parishioners smiling together at a table in the parish hall

parish.name: Pan-Orthodox and Social Media
parish.text: Connects us with other Orthodox parishes nearby and shares the life of our parish on social media.
parish.image_alt: Clergy from several parishes in green vestments serving together outdoors

parish.name: Youth Ministry
parish.text: Learning, activities and friendship for the children and teens of the parish.

parish.name: Landscaping and Church Decoration
parish.text: Plants and tends our flower beds, and decorates the church with flowers and greenery for the feasts.
parish.image_alt: Parishioners making garlands of evergreen branches to decorate the church

parish.name: Young Adults and Catechumens
parish.text: A place for young adults and for those learning the Orthodox faith to meet, ask questions and grow in friendship.
parish.image_alt: Young adults talking around a table in the parish hall

entries.name: Wednesday Bible Study and the Jesus Prayer
entries.when: Wednesdays: Vespers 6:00 PM, Bible Study 6:45 PM, Jesus Prayer 7:30 PM
entries.text: We read Scripture together, then spend time in the quiet, repeated prayer "Lord Jesus Christ, Son of God, have mercy on me." Everyone is welcome; no preparation needed.

entries.name: Catechumens Class
entries.text: Step-by-step teaching for those preparing to become Orthodox. Talk with Fr. Arkady to join.

entries.name: Coffee hour
entries.text: Food, conversation and a warm welcome. The best place to meet the parish and ask questions.

entries.name: Church School
entries.when: Second Sunday of each month, right after Communion
entries.text: Children learn the faith through stories, crafts and the life of the Church.
